name: Spark Controller
summary: Fans, RGB lighting and firmware updates for this PC, in one place.
summary_fr: Ventilateurs, éclairage RGB et mises à jour du firmware de ce PC, au même endroit.

optional.liquidctl: NZXT and other USB coolers and lighting controllers (Python library)
optional.openrgb: ASUS Aura, mice, keyboards and memory lighting (command line)

needs.system: Linux with /sys/class/hwmon and systemd; polkit for saving fan curves
